package contracts_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	svc "example.com/interceptorcontracts/gen/contracts"
	hc "example.com/interceptorcontracts/gen/http/contracts/client"
	hs "example.com/interceptorcontracts/gen/http/contracts/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type (
	audit struct {
		side string
	}
	service struct {
		calls atomic.Int32
	}
)

func TestMountedStorageBindings(t *testing.T) {
	implementation := &service{}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	hs.Mount(mux, hs.New(svc.NewEndpoints(implementation, audit{"server"}), mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
	server := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer server.Close()
	transport := hc.NewClient("http", strings.TrimPrefix(server.URL, "http://"), server.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	client := svc.NewClient(transport.First(), transport.Second(), audit{"client"})
	optional, err := client.First(context.Background(), &svc.FirstPayload{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, optional.Value)
	require.Equal(t, ":client:server:server-result:client-result", *optional.Value)
	required, err := client.Second(context.Background(), &svc.SecondPayload{})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, *optional.Value, required.Value)
	require.Equal(t, int32(2), implementation.calls.Load())
}

func TestBindingErrorPropagation(t *testing.T) {
	sentinel := errors.New("endpoint failed")
	client := svc.NewClient(nil, func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
		return nil, sentinel
	}, audit{"client"})
	_, err := client.Second(context.Background(), &svc.SecondPayload{})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, sentinel)
}

func (a audit) Audit(ctx context.Context, info *svc.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	payload := info.Payload()
	payload.SetValue(payload.Value() + ":" + a.side)
	result, err := next(ctx, info.RawPayload())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	access := info.Result(result)
	access.SetValue(access.Value() + ":" + a.side + "-result")
	return result, nil
}

func (s *service) First(_ context.Context, p *svc.FirstPayload) (*svc.FirstResult, error) {
	s.calls.Add(1)
	return &svc.FirstResult{Value: p.Value}, nil
}

func (s *service) Second(_ context.Context, p *svc.SecondPayload) (*svc.SecondResult, error) {
	s.calls.Add(1)
	return &svc.SecondResult{Value: p.Value}, nil
}
